findings.description: Permits were filed for a two-unit residential duplex on a vacant, roughly 0.06-acre lot at 1912 20th Street in Potrero Hill, between Carolina and De Haro streets. The lower unit would span 3,430 square feet from basement to second floor and the upper 3,040 square feet from third to fifth floors, each with three bedrooms; parking for three cars and two bicycles is included. Studio 12 Architecture designed the project, estimated to cost about $2.37 million, with no construction timeline yet given. This is a proposal for a building that does not yet exist; the property's owner is not recorded here.

citation.label: San Francisco YIMBY, “Duplex Proposed For 1912 20th Street, Potrero Hill, San Francisco,” 27 September 2026

raw.text: Permits have been filed for a two-unit residential infill project at 1912 20th Street in San Francisco's Potrero Hill neighborhood. The project would bring new housing to a vacant lot.
